question.wording: Is this an insurance premium paid by a pretax reduction of the taxpayer's pay (a cafeteria plan), so not included in box 1 of the Form W-2?

options.label: No — paid with after-tax money, or not a premium

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this an insurance premium paid by a pretax reduction of the taxpayer's pay (a cafeteria plan), so not included in box 1 of the Form W-2?

citation.wording: You can’t deduct amounts that have already been excluded from your income, so don’t include on line 1 insurance premiums paid by an employer-sponsored health insurance plan (cafeteria plan) unless the premiums are included in box 1 of your Form(s) W-2.
